query.sql:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON)
select 
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  count(*) cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  count(*) cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  count(*) cnt3
 from
  customer c,customer_address ca,customer_demographics
 where
  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk and
  ca_state in ('MI','NC','TN') and
  cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
  and cd_marital_status in ('S', 'W', 'M')
  and cd_education_status in ('Primary', 'Advanced Degree') and
  exists (select *
          from store_sales,date_dim
          where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and
                ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and
                d_year = 2002 and
                d_moy between 6 and 6+2
                and ss_list_price between 77 and 166
          ) and
   (not exists (select *
            from web_sales,date_dim
            where c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and
                  ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and
                  d_year = 2002 and
                  d_moy between 6 and 6+2
                  and ws_list_price between 77 and 166
            ) and
    not exists (select *
            from catalog_sales,date_dim
            where c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk and
                  cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and
                  d_year = 2002 and
                  d_moy between 6 and 6+2
                  and cs_list_price between 77 and 166)
            )
 group by cd_gender,
          cd_marital_status,
          cd_education_status,
          cd_purchase_estimate,
          cd_credit_rating
 order by cd_gender,
          cd_marital_status,
          cd_education_status,
          cd_purchase_estimate,
          cd_credit_rating
 limit 100
;
